equation.exposition_role: restricted PPE roll-forward and nonnegative retirement carrying amount
equation.symbols_units_domain: G is gross cost; B accumulated depreciation; A additions; R retired cost; d expense; S retired depreciation, all USD million.

equation.source_and_equality: Cost bookkeeping gives G1=G0+A-R and B1=B0+d-S; nonnegative retired carrying amount requires S<=R.
